name: inchworm
instructions:
1. In an upright position, reach forward and touch the floor with your fingertips.
2. Walk your hands forward until you’re in a pushup position.
3. While keeping your knees locked out, tuck your chin to look at your shoes and tip-toe your feet up towards your hands as far as possible.
4. Walk your hands back out to a pushup position and repeat the process for desired number of repetitions.
